legend: There are n psychos standing in a line. Each psycho is assigned a unique integer from 1 to n. At each step every psycho who has an id greater than the psycho to his right (if exists) kills his right neighbor in the line. Note that a psycho might kill and get killed at the same step.

You're given the initial arrangement of the psychos in the line. Calculate how many steps are needed to the moment of time such, that nobody kills his neighbor after that moment. Look notes to understand the statement more precise.
input: The first line of input contains integer n denoting the number of psychos, (1 ≤ n ≤ 105). In the second line there will be a list of n space separated distinct integers each in range 1 to n, inclusive — ids of the psychos in the line from left to right.
output: Print the number of steps, so that the line remains the same afterward.
note: In the first sample line of the psychos transforms as follows: [10 9 7 8 6 5 3 4 2 1]  →  [10 8 4]  →  [10]. So, there are two steps.

legend.ai: 有 n 个精神病患者站成一排。每个精神病患者都被分配了一个从 1 到 n 的互不相同的整数。在每一步中，所有编号大于其右侧精神病患者编号（如果右侧存在精神病患者）的精神病患者，都会杀死自己右边的邻居。注意，一个精神病患者可能在同一步中既杀死别人，又被别人杀死。
给定队列中精神病人的初始排列。计算需要经过多少步，才能到达这样一个时刻：从这一时刻起，没有人会再杀死自己的邻居。请阅读注释，以更准确地理解题意。

input.ai: 输入第一行包含整数 n，表示精神病人的数量（1 ≤ n ≤ 105）。第二行包含 n 个以空格分隔的互不相同的整数，每个整数均在 1 到 n 的范围内（包括边界），表示队列中从左到右精神病人的编号。

output.ai: 输出步数，使得此后队列保持不变。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，精神病人的队列变化如下：[10 9 7 8 6 5 3 4 2 1]  →  [10 8 4]  →  [10]。因此，需要两步。

titleZh.ai: B. 排队的精神病患者
